name: UJam Skill Preview — LoL screenshot study
colorSpace: sRGB; RGB8; alpha is linear coverage
measurementNote: RGB values are composited screenshot samples, NOT official Riot texture/source RGB. Deep Teal and all alpha values are authored choices. Still images do not establish temporal color animation.
brightnessNote: HSV V is not perceptual brightness. Relative luminance Y is calculated from linearized sRGB using Rec.709 weights.
rendering: Unlit, straight-alpha blending, no lighting or shadows. Circle center alpha target ~0.08, rectangle fill ~0.24..0.34. Generated artwork approximates these anchors with continuous gradients.
method: Origin at top-left. System.Drawing.Bitmap.GetPixel on original attachments. Circular annuli: image1 center(462,285), radii(163,128), normalized r .83..1.04; image3 center(193,101), radii(73,51), r .79..1.04. Cyan filter G-R>35, B-R>20, G>110, B>110. Exclude red annotation, UI, large range ring overlap. Rectangle rails and fill below y=280.
